## Goal

`RemotePort.replaceIssueLabel(number, { remove, add })` in gh, glab and the harness FakeRemote, proven by the remote contract suite (AC1–AC3). Unused by norn for now (slice 07 calls it).

## Progress

- Port method in `packages/core/src/ports.ts`; three new `remoteContract` tests (swap, old label missing, provider fails → PortError and nothing changes). Red on all three subjects, then green.
